definitions.short: a cup ; also a bag for money or weights
definitions.full: H3599. kis כִּיס noun masculine Prov 1:14 bag, purse (perhaps kindred with כּוֺס , q. v.; Arabic (probably from Persian Lane 2640 ); Ethiopic Late Hebrew כִּיס ; Aramaic כִּיסָא , , Palmyrene כיסה מן from his purse = at his own expense, Vog p. 13 and others) — bag , in which were carried: a. weights (see אֶבֶן 5 ) Deut 25:13 ; Micah 6:11 ; Prov 16:11 ; b. money , i.e. a purse Isa 46:6 ; Prov 1:14 . כִּיִּר , [ כִּיר ], כִּירַיִם see below I. כור . כִּישׁוֺר see below כשׁר . כָּ֫כָה see below כה above כִּכָּר see below כרר ; כֹּל see below I. כלל .
